tools.name: check_spend
tools.description: Check whether a proposed agent spend is inside a task envelope. Returns verdict, rule, reason, counterfactual and next. No state is stored.

tools.name: open_envelope
tools.description: Create a signed budget envelope for one task: total budget, per-call cap, call count, allowlisted payees, subscription rule, expiry. Stores it in this server's local ledger (no funds move, no keys). Returns the envelope id. Capped at 30 envelopes/hour per server.

tools.name: get_envelope
tools.description: Return an envelope's state: budget, per-call cap, calls used, spent, remaining, allowlist and expiry. Read-only.

tools.name: kill_envelope
tools.description: Stop one task envelope immediately: no further spend is approved for it, the reason is recorded with a timestamp. Idempotent — the first reason wins.

tools.name: envelope_evidence
tools.description: Return an evidence bundle for one envelope: state, every recorded spend, the stop record and a sha256 of the whole pack that anyone can recompute. Read-only.

tools.name: policy_rules
tools.description: List the deterministic rules a spend is checked against (E01-E08) with the order they are applied and the meaning of each. Read-only, no state.
